hero.caption: Network Rail's Multi-Purpose Vehicles 98922 and 98972 emerge from Fisherton Tunnel and take the Romsey route. They are working as a Rail Head Treatment Train at a spot where low rail adhesion on the London route to the right is thought to be the cause of a recent train collision.
